job_title: Youth, Teen, and Family Community Recreation Programmer I
job_description:
Important Notice: Arlington County requires all applicants to thoroughly complete each section of the application, including prior job responsibilities, duties, and supplemental questions. While you may attach a resume, it will not replace a completed application. Incomplete applications will not be considered.

The Department of Parks & Recreation (DPR) is hiring a Youth, Teen, and Family Community Recreation Programmer I to plan, implement, coordinate and manage recreational programming for Arlington youth ages 5-18 including camps, after school programs, special events, and late-night programming. Among other youth programs, this position will primarily focus on out-of-school time (OST) programming for teenagers and summer camp programs for elementary age youth. The position will collaborate with staff, volunteers, and community partners to create a safe, inclusive, and fun environment while ensuring programs meet the needs and interests of participants. This role requires creativity, strong leadership skills, and a passion for working with youth.
